nodes.name: Sunday 06:00 America/New_York
nodes.notes: THE CLOCK. The cron is plain (0 6 * * 0 = Sunday 06:00) and the timezone comes from the workflow settings above, which are set to America/New_York. Do not put a UTC offset in the expression: DST would silently move the poll by an hour twice a season, in the middle of it.

nodes.name: Dispatch weekly.yml
nodes.notes: POST /repos/vyhlidal/cfb-poll/actions/workflows/weekly.yml/dispatches. Success is HTTP 204 with an empty body. The workflow FILE NAME works as the {workflow_id} path segment, which is why nothing here has to look up a numeric id. Retries three times because a transient GitHub 5xx on the one clock that matters is worth three seconds of patience.

meta.description: THE PRIMARY CLOCK for the Sunday poll (ADR 0002). Two nodes, no daemon, no port, no TLS, no database. Import, attach the credential, do NOT activate until ops/arming.toml has `n8n = true` on main - the GitHub side no-ops until then, so activating early costs a wasted dispatch rather than a bad publication, but there is no reason to spend it. Runbook: docs/runbooks/sunday-automation.md
